title: The effect of position on the percentage of body mass supported during traditional and modified push-up variants
journal: Journal of Strength and Conditioning Research
population: Adults in traditional and modified push-up positions (force-plate % body mass)

keyFinding.enGB: Measured roughly 69–75% of body mass supported in traditional push-up positions, with lower fractions in modified variants.
